title: postapipostcreateappwithvaliddata
description: Test POST /api/v1/apps/post to create a new app with valid data and verify the response contains the app with isEnabled set to false by default.

title: patchappsupdateappwithvalidchanges
description: Test PATCH /api/v1/apps/update/{appId} to update app details like name and requestInterval and verify the updated app is returned correctly.

title: patchappsenableapptogglesenabledstate
description: Test PATCH /api/v1/apps/enable/{appId} to enable a disabled app and verify isEnabled is true; also test idempotency by enabling an already enabled app.

title: patchappsdisableapptogglesenabledstate
description: Test PATCH /api/v1/apps/disable/{appId} to disable an enabled app and verify isEnabled is false; also test idempotency by disabling an already disabled app.

title: deleteappsdeleteappwithvalidid
description: Test DELETE /api/v1/apps/delete/{appId} to delete an existing app and verify success; also test deleting a non-existent app returns 404.

title: postrequestspostrequesttimewithvalidinterval
description: Test POST /api/v1/requests/post-request-time with valid startTime before endTime and verify creation of request time frame.

title: postrequestspostrequesttimewithinvalidinterval
description: Test POST /api/v1/requests/post-request-time with startTime equal or after endTime and verify 400 error with appropriate message.

title: getrequestsgetliveprovidesseestream
description: Test GET /api/v1/requests/get-live with valid authorization returns 200 and streams live request events via SSE; test missing or expired token returns 401.

title: postfeedbackpostfeedbackwithvaliddata
description: Test POST /api/v1/feedback/post with valid user token and feedback data and verify creation of feedback entry.

title: getmetricsreturnsprometheusmetrics
description: Test GET /metrics returns 200 with Prometheus metrics plaintext body and handles high load gracefully; server errors return 500 with error message.
